title: Cartwise+ Plan Goodwill Raise on Limit-Review Claims, Cartwise Grocery Orders
content:
The limit-review claim amount on a Cartwise Grocery Orders order carries a goodwill raise that turns on the Cartwise+ Membership recorded on the order. The raise applies to the claim value plus its service-fee part, and the result is rounded to the cent:

| Cartwise+ plan recorded on the order | Membership ledger | Goodwill raise |
|---|---|---|
| Monthly plan | at least 6 period fees charged within the last 6 whole calendar months | 10 percent |
| Annual plan | at least 1 period fee charged within the last 12 whole calendar months | 15 percent |
| Any other position, or no plan | — | no raise |

**In clause form.** When the membership recorded on the order is on a monthly plan and the customer's membership ledger shows at least 6 period fees charged within the last 6 whole calendar months, the raise is 10 percent; when that membership is on an annual plan and the ledger shows at least 1 period fee charged within the last 12 whole calendar months, it is 15 percent; otherwise there is no raise.

**Counting months.** Months are counted by anniversary: between an earlier date and a later date as many whole months have passed as there are monthly anniversaries of the earlier date falling on or before the later date, so a period fee counts as charged within the last N whole calendar months when fewer than N such months have passed from its charge date to today, and a fee charged earlier in the current month is 0 months old.

### Member cases (hypothetical, figure before the raise 15.00)

- Monthly plan, 6 qualifying period fees: 15.00 raised by 10 percent, 16.50.
- Monthly plan, 5 qualifying period fees: no raise, 15.00.
- Annual plan, 1 qualifying period fee: 15.00 raised by 15 percent, 17.25.
- Annual plan whose only period fee was charged 12 whole months ago (for example charged 20 September last year, today 20 September): that fee is not within the last 12 whole months, so no raise, 15.00.
- Annual plan, fee charged 21 September last year, today 20 September: 11 whole months have passed, the fee counts, 17.25.
